text:
nina (People Ops): Leaving this live thread from today's all-hands for short follow-ups on promotions / leveling / comp. Drop one-line Qs. If private, DM People Ops.

omar (Eng): Is there a recommended script for managers announcing promotions to ICs? want to make it clear about expectations.

sam (People Ops Lead): Short script we recommend: 1) Congrats + specific impact example, 2) New title/level & effective date, 3) Any change to comp or manager next steps, 4) Invite questions. We can paste a template if you want.

jules (Design): For leveling, will we get detailed feedback points in the notification or just the outcome? helps roadmap conversations.

sam (People Ops Lead): Managers will receive the outcome email with the rationale bullets we used in calibration. ICs get a streamlined note with role/level and 2 summary points. If you want deeper feedback, ask your manager to share the manager notes.

omar (Eng): manager is on parental leave and couldn't fill the packet. Is there anything I should prepare to avoid delay?

nina (People Ops): Please upload your self-eval and 3 peer notes to the packet link. We'll flag it and the panel will consider the alternate evidence. We may ask you for a short addendum.

jules (Design): appeals window?

sam (People Ops Lead): 7 calendar days from the notification email. Provide examples/links. Appeals reviewed by a cross-functional panel.

finance-bot: FYI: payroll processes HRIS changes in the next payroll cycle; retro pay appears as a single adjustment line. Contact payroll@redwood for case-specific questions.

nina (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 1-2pm PT if anyone wants help preparing a manager-absent addendum or reviewing phrasing. We'll post the manager script and addendum template in the people-ops docs after lunch.
